author: Antigravity
description: A sniper strategy for catching deep dips that stabilize at the RSI 20-23 level with a Pinbar confirmation. Avoids the 'Waterfall' risk of RSI < 20.
rule_logic: mom_5d <= -10 AND rsi >= 20 AND rsi <= 23 AND shadow_ratio >= 0.25
discovery_notes: AGIX is a dangerous 'Falling Knife' coin. Blind dip buying fails 90% of the time.
RSI < 20 is a 'Death Zone' where price often continues to crash (Waterfall).
Geometric confirmation (Pinbar/Lower Shadow >= 0.25) is required to confirm rejection.
This filters out the 'solid red' capitulation candles that have no buying pressure.
